10 /-!
11 # Disjointness and complements
12 
13 This file defines `Disjoint`, `Codisjoint`, and the `IsCompl` predicate.
14 
15 ## Main declarations
16 
17 * `Disjoint x y`: two elements of a lattice are disjoint if their `inf` is the bottom element.
18 * `Codisjoint x y`: two elements of a lattice are codisjoint if their `join` is the top element.
19 * `IsCompl x y`: In a bounded lattice, predicate for "`x` is a complement of `y`". Note that in a
20   non-distributive lattice, an element can have several complements.
21 * `ComplementedLattice α`: Typeclass stating that any element of a lattice has a complement.
22 
23 -/
24

33 section PartialOrderBot

35 variable [PartialOrder α] [OrderBot α] {a b c d : α}
36 
37 /-- Two elements of a lattice are disjoint if their inf is the bottom element.
38   (This generalizes disjoint sets, viewed as members of the subset lattice.)
39 
40 Note that we define this without reference to `⊓`, as this allows us to talk about orders where
41 the infimum is not unique, or where implementing `Inf` would require additional `Decidable`
42 arguments. -/
43 @[to_dual /-- Two elements of a lattice are codisjoint if their sup is the top element.
44 
45 Note that we define this without reference to `⊔`, as this allows us to talk about orders where
46 the supremum is not unique, or where implementing `Sup` would require additional `Decidable`
47 arguments. -/]
48 def Disjoint (a b : α) : Prop :=
49   ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ≤ a → x ≤ b → x ≤ ⊥
50 
51 @[to_dual (attr := simp)]
52 theorem disjoint_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton α] : Disjoint a b :=
53   fun x _ _ ↦ le_of_eq (Subsingleton.elim x ⊥)
54 
55 @[to_dual (attr := grind =)]
56 theorem disjoint_comm : Disjoint a b ↔ Disjoint b a :=
57   forall_congr' fun _ ↦ forall_comm
58 
59 @[to_dual (attr := symm)]
60 theorem Disjoint.symm ⦃a b : α⦄ : Disjoint a b → Disjoint b a :=
61   disjoint_comm.1
62 
63 @[to_dual]
64 theorem symmetric_disjoint : Symmetric (Disjoint : α → α → Prop) :=
65   Disjoint.symm
66 
67 @[to_dual (attr := simp, grind ←)]
68 theorem disjoint_bot_left : Disjoint ⊥ a := fun _ hbot _ ↦ hbot
69 
70 @[to_dual (attr := simp)]
71 theorem disjoint_bot_right : Disjoint a ⊥ := fun _ _ hbot ↦ hbot
72 
73 @[to_dual (attr := gcongr)]
74 theorem Disjoint.mono (h₁ : a ≤ b) (h₂ : c ≤ d) : Disjoint b d → Disjoint a c :=
75   fun h _ ha hc ↦ h (ha.trans h₁) (hc.trans h₂)
76 
77 @[to_dual]
78 theorem Disjoint.mono_left (h : a ≤ b) : Disjoint b c → Disjoint a c :=
79   Disjoint.mono h le_rfl
80 
81 grind_pattern Disjoint.mono_left => a ≤ b, Disjoint b c
82 grind_pattern Disjoint.mono_left => a ≤ b, Disjoint a c
83 grind_pattern Codisjoint.mono_left => a ≤ b, Codisjoint a c
84 grind_pattern Codisjoint.mono_left => a ≤ b, Codisjoint b c
85 
86 @[to_dual]
87 theorem Disjoint.mono_right (h : b ≤ c) : Disjoint a c → Disjoint a b :=
88   Disjoint.mono le_rfl h
89 
90 -- Note: we don't need separate `grind` patterns for `Disjoint.mono_right` because `grind`
91 -- will use `disjoint_comm`.
92 
93 @[to_dual]
94 theorem Disjoint.out (h : Disjoint a b) (x : α) : x ≤ a → x ≤ b → x = ⊥ :=
95   fun h₁ h₂ => by simpa using h h₁ h₂
96 
97 @[to_dual (attr := simp, grind =)]
98 theorem disjoint_self : Disjoint a a ↔ a = ⊥ :=
99   ⟨fun hd ↦ bot_unique <| hd le_rfl le_rfl, fun h _ ha _ ↦ ha.trans_eq h⟩
100 
101 /- TODO: Rename `Disjoint.eq_bot` to `Disjoint.inf_eq` and `Disjoint.eq_bot_of_self` to
102 `Disjoint.eq_bot` -/
103 @[to_dual]
104 alias ⟨Disjoint.eq_bot_of_self, _⟩ := disjoint_self
105 
106 @[to_dual]
107 theorem Disjoint.ne (ha : a ≠ ⊥) (hab : Disjoint a b) : a ≠ b :=
108   fun h ↦ ha <| disjoint_self.1 <| by rwa [← h] at hab
109 
110 @[to_dual]
111 theorem Disjoint.eq_bot_of_le (hab : Disjoint a b) (h : a ≤ b) : a = ⊥ :=
112   eq_bot_iff.2 <| hab le_rfl h
113 
114 grind_pattern Disjoint.eq_bot_of_le => Disjoint a b, a ≤ b
115 grind_pattern Codisjoint.eq_top_of_le => Codisjoint a b, b ≤ a
116 
117 @[to_dual]
118 theorem Disjoint.eq_bot_of_ge (hab : Disjoint a b) : b ≤ a → b = ⊥ :=
119   hab.symm.eq_bot_of_le
120 
121 grind_pattern Disjoint.eq_bot_of_le => Disjoint a b, b ≤ a
122 grind_pattern Codisjoint.eq_top_of_ge => Codisjoint a b, a ≤ b
123 
124 @[to_dual] lemma Disjoint.eq_iff (hab : Disjoint a b) : a = b ↔ a = ⊥ ∧ b = ⊥ := by grind
125 @[to_dual] lemma Disjoint.ne_iff (hab : Disjoint a b) : a ≠ b ↔ a ≠ ⊥ ∨ b ≠ ⊥ := by grind
126 
127 theorem disjoint_of_le_iff_left_eq_bot (h : a ≤ b) :
128     Disjoint a b ↔ a = ⊥ := by grind
129 
130 end PartialOrderBot

136 @[to_dual (attr := simp, grind =)]
137 theorem disjoint_top : Disjoint a ⊤ ↔ a = ⊥ :=
138   ⟨fun h ↦ bot_unique <| h le_rfl le_top, fun h _ ha _ ↦ ha.trans_eq h⟩
139 
140 @[to_dual (attr := simp, grind =)]
141 theorem top_disjoint : Disjoint ⊤ a ↔ a = ⊥ :=
142   ⟨fun h ↦ bot_unique <| h le_top le_rfl, fun h _ _ ha ↦ ha.trans_eq h⟩
143 
144 @[to_dual]
145 theorem Disjoint.ne_top_of_ne_bot (h : Disjoint a b) (ha : a ≠ ⊥) : b ≠ ⊤ := by
146   grind
147 
148 @[deprecated ne_bot_of_ne_top (since := "2025-11-07")]
149 lemma Codisjoint.ne_bot_of_ne_top' (h : Codisjoint a b) (hb : b ≠ ⊤) : a ≠ ⊥ :=

154 section SemilatticeInfBot
155 
156 variable [SemilatticeInf α] [OrderBot α] {a b c : α}
157 
158 -- I would like to mark this as `@[grind =]`, but it results in excessive case splitting.
159 @[to_dual codisjoint_iff_le_sup]
160 theorem disjoint_iff_inf_le : Disjoint a b ↔ a ⊓ b ≤ ⊥ :=
161   ⟨fun hd ↦ hd inf_le_left inf_le_right, fun h _ ha hb ↦ (le_inf ha hb).trans h⟩
162 
163 @[to_dual]
164 theorem disjoint_iff : Disjoint a b ↔ a ⊓ b = ⊥ :=
165   disjoint_iff_inf_le.trans le_bot_iff
166 
167 @[to_dual (attr := simp)]
168 lemma disjoint_subtype_iff {pr : α → Prop} (Pinf : ∀ ⦃s t : α⦄, pr s → pr t → pr (s ⊓ t))
169     (hbot : pr (⊥ : α)) {a b : Subtype pr} :
170     letI : SemilatticeInf (Subtype pr) := Subtype.semilatticeInf Pinf
171     letI : OrderBot (Subtype pr) := Subtype.orderBot hbot
172     Disjoint a b ↔ Disjoint a.val b.val := by
173   letI : SemilatticeInf (Subtype pr) := Subtype.semilatticeInf Pinf
174   letI : OrderBot (Subtype pr) := Subtype.orderBot hbot
175   rw [disjoint_iff, disjoint_iff, ← Subtype.coe_inf Pinf, ← Subtype.coe_bot hbot]
176   exact Subtype.coe_inj.symm
177 
178 @[to_dual top_le]
179 theorem Disjoint.le_bot : Disjoint a b → a ⊓ b ≤ ⊥ :=
180   disjoint_iff_inf_le.mp
181 
182 @[to_dual]
183 theorem Disjoint.eq_bot : Disjoint a b → a ⊓ b = ⊥ :=
184   bot_unique ∘ Disjoint.le_bot
185 
186 @[to_dual]
187 theorem disjoint_assoc : Disjoint (a ⊓ b) c ↔ Disjoint a (b ⊓ c) := by
188   grind [disjoint_iff_inf_le]
189 
190 @[to_dual]
191 theorem disjoint_left_comm : Disjoint a (b ⊓ c) ↔ Disjoint b (a ⊓ c) := by
192   grind [disjoint_iff_inf_le]
193 
194 @[to_dual]
195 theorem disjoint_right_comm : Disjoint (a ⊓ b) c ↔ Disjoint (a ⊓ c) b := by
196   grind [disjoint_iff_inf_le]
197 
198 variable (c)
199 
200 @[to_dual]
201 theorem Disjoint.inf_left (h : Disjoint a b) : Disjoint (a ⊓ c) b :=
202   h.mono_left inf_le_left
203 
204 @[to_dual]
205 theorem Disjoint.inf_left' (h : Disjoint a b) : Disjoint (c ⊓ a) b :=
206   h.mono_left inf_le_right
207 
208 @[to_dual]
209 theorem Disjoint.inf_right (h : Disjoint a b) : Disjoint a (b ⊓ c) :=
210   h.mono_right inf_le_left
211 
212 @[to_dual]
213 theorem Disjoint.inf_right' (h : Disjoint a b) : Disjoint a (c ⊓ b) :=
214   h.mono_right inf_le_right
215 
216 variable {c}
217 
218 @[to_dual]
219 theorem Disjoint.of_disjoint_inf_of_le (h : Disjoint (a ⊓ b) c) (hle : a ≤ c) : Disjoint a b :=
220   disjoint_iff.2 <| h.eq_bot_of_le <| inf_le_of_left_le hle
221 
222 @[to_dual]
223 theorem Disjoint.of_disjoint_inf_of_le' (h : Disjoint (a ⊓ b) c) (hle : b ≤ c) : Disjoint a b :=
224   disjoint_iff.2 <| h.eq_bot_of_le <| inf_le_of_right_le hle
225 
226 end SemilatticeInfBot
227 
228 @[to_dual sup_lt_right_of_left_ne_bot]
229 theorem Disjoint.right_lt_sup_of_left_ne_bot [SemilatticeSup α] [OrderBot α] {a b : α}
230     (h : Disjoint a b) (ha : a ≠ ⊥) : b < a ⊔ b :=
231   le_sup_right.lt_of_ne fun eq ↦ ha (le_bot_iff.mp <| h le_rfl <| sup_eq_right.mp eq.symm)

233 section DistribLatticeBot

235 variable [DistribLattice α] [OrderBot α] {a b c : α}
236 
237 @[simp]
238 theorem disjoint_sup_left : Disjoint (a ⊔ b) c ↔ Disjoint a c ∧ Disjoint b c := by
239   simp only [disjoint_iff, inf_sup_right, sup_eq_bot_iff]
240 
241 @[simp]
242 theorem disjoint_sup_right : Disjoint a (b ⊔ c) ↔ Disjoint a b ∧ Disjoint a c := by
243   simp only [disjoint_iff, inf_sup_left, sup_eq_bot_iff]
244 
245 theorem Disjoint.sup_left (ha : Disjoint a c) (hb : Disjoint b c) : Disjoint (a ⊔ b) c :=
246   disjoint_sup_left.2 ⟨ha, hb⟩
247 
248 theorem Disjoint.sup_right (hb : Disjoint a b) (hc : Disjoint a c) : Disjoint a (b ⊔ c) :=
249   disjoint_sup_right.2 ⟨hb, hc⟩
250 
251 theorem Disjoint.left_le_of_le_sup_right (h : a ≤ b ⊔ c) (hd : Disjoint a c) : a ≤ b :=
252   le_of_inf_le_sup_le (le_trans hd.le_bot bot_le) <| sup_le h le_sup_right
253 
254 theorem Disjoint.left_le_of_le_sup_left (h : a ≤ c ⊔ b) (hd : Disjoint a c) : a ≤ b :=
255   hd.left_le_of_le_sup_right <| by rwa [sup_comm]
256 
257 end DistribLatticeBot
258

267 @[simp]

313   rw [← @inf_top_eq _ _ _ a, ← @bot_sup_eq _ _ _ c, ← hab.eq_bot, ← hbc.eq_top, sup_inf_right]

318 section IsCompl
319 
320 /-- Two elements `x` and `y` are complements of each other if `x ⊔ y = ⊤` and `x ⊓ y = ⊥`. -/
321 structure IsCompl [PartialOrder α] [BoundedOrder α] (x y : α) : Prop where
322   /-- If `x` and `y` are to be complementary in an order, they should be disjoint. -/
323   protected disjoint : Disjoint x y
324   /-- If `x` and `y` are to be complementary in an order, they should be codisjoint. -/
325   protected codisjoint : Codisjoint x y
326 
327 attribute [to_dual existing] IsCompl.disjoint
328 attribute [to_dual self (reorder := disjoint codisjoint)] IsCompl.mk
329 
330 @[to_dual isCompl_iff']
331 theorem isCompl_iff [PartialOrder α] [BoundedOrder α] {a b : α} :
332     IsCompl a b ↔ Disjoint a b ∧ Codisjoint a b :=
333   ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.1, h.2⟩, fun h ↦ ⟨h.1, h.2⟩⟩
334 
335 namespace IsCompl
336 
337 section BoundedPartialOrder
338 
339 variable [PartialOrder α] [BoundedOrder α] {x y : α}
340 
341 @[symm]
342 protected theorem symm (h : IsCompl x y) : IsCompl y x :=
343   ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.symm⟩
344 
345 @[grind =]
346 lemma _root_.isCompl_comm : IsCompl x y ↔ IsCompl y x := ⟨IsCompl.symm, IsCompl.symm⟩
347 
348 theorem dual (h : IsCompl x y) : IsCompl (toDual x) (toDual y) :=
349   ⟨h.2, h.1⟩
350 
351 theorem ofDual {a b : αᵒᵈ} (h : IsCompl a b) : IsCompl (ofDual a) (ofDual b) :=
352   ⟨h.2, h.1⟩
353 
354 end BoundedPartialOrder

356 section BoundedLattice
357 
358 variable [Lattice α] [BoundedOrder α] {x y : α}
359 
360 @[to_dual self (reorder := h₁ h₂)]
361 theorem of_le (h₁ : x ⊓ y ≤ ⊥) (h₂ : ⊤ ≤ x ⊔ y) : IsCompl x y :=
362   ⟨by grind [disjoint_iff_inf_le], by grind [codisjoint_iff_le_sup]⟩
363 
364 @[to_dual self (reorder := h₁ h₂)]
365 theorem of_eq (h₁ : x ⊓ y = ⊥) (h₂ : x ⊔ y = ⊤) : IsCompl x y :=
366   ⟨disjoint_iff.mpr h₁, codisjoint_iff.mpr h₂⟩
367 
368 @[to_dual]
369 theorem inf_eq_bot (h : IsCompl x y) : x ⊓ y = ⊥ :=
370   h.disjoint.eq_bot
371 
372 end BoundedLattice
373 
374 variable [DistribLattice α] [BoundedOrder α] {a b x y z : α}
375 
376 theorem inf_left_le_of_le_sup_right (h : IsCompl x y) (hle : a ≤ b ⊔ y) : a ⊓ x ≤ b :=
377   calc
378     a ⊓ x ≤ (b ⊔ y) ⊓ x := inf_le_inf hle le_rfl
379     _ = b ⊓ x ⊔ y ⊓ x := inf_sup_right _ _ _
380     _ = b ⊓ x := by rw [h.symm.inf_eq_bot, sup_bot_eq]
381     _ ≤ b := inf_le_left
382 
383 theorem le_sup_right_iff_inf_left_le {a b} (h : IsCompl x y) : a ≤ b ⊔ y ↔ a ⊓ x ≤ b :=
384   ⟨h.inf_left_le_of_le_sup_right, h.symm.dual.inf_left_le_of_le_sup_right⟩
385 
386 theorem inf_left_eq_bot_iff (h : IsCompl y z) : x ⊓ y = ⊥ ↔ x ≤ z := by
387   rw [← le_bot_iff, ← h.le_sup_right_iff_inf_left_le, bot_sup_eq]
388 
389 theorem inf_right_eq_bot_iff (h : IsCompl y z) : x ⊓ z = ⊥ ↔ x ≤ y :=
390   h.symm.inf_left_eq_bot_iff
391 
392 theorem disjoint_left_iff (h : IsCompl y z) : Disjoint x y ↔ x ≤ z := by
393   rw [disjoint_iff]
394   exact h.inf_left_eq_bot_iff
395 
396 theorem disjoint_right_iff (h : IsCompl y z) : Disjoint x z ↔ x ≤ y :=
397   h.symm.disjoint_left_iff
398 
399 theorem le_left_iff (h : IsCompl x y) : z ≤ x ↔ Disjoint z y :=
400   h.disjoint_right_iff.symm
401 
402 theorem le_right_iff (h : IsCompl x y) : z ≤ y ↔ Disjoint z x :=
403   h.symm.le_left_iff
404 
405 theorem left_le_iff (h : IsCompl x y) : x ≤ z ↔ Codisjoint z y :=
406   h.dual.le_left_iff
407 
408 theorem right_le_iff (h : IsCompl x y) : y ≤ z ↔ Codisjoint z x :=
409   h.symm.left_le_iff
410 
411 protected theorem Antitone {x' y'} (h : IsCompl x y) (h' : IsCompl x' y') (hx : x ≤ x') : y' ≤ y :=
412   h'.right_le_iff.2 <| h.symm.codisjoint.mono_right hx
413 
414 theorem right_unique (hxy : IsCompl x y) (hxz : IsCompl x z) : y = z :=
415   le_antisymm (hxz.Antitone hxy <| le_refl x) (hxy.Antitone hxz <| le_refl x)
416 
417 theorem left_unique (hxz : IsCompl x z) (hyz : IsCompl y z) : x = y :=
418   hxz.symm.right_unique hyz.symm
419 
420 theorem sup_inf {x' y'} (h : IsCompl x y) (h' : IsCompl x' y') : IsCompl (x ⊔ x') (y ⊓ y') :=
421   of_eq
422     (by rw [inf_sup_right, ← inf_assoc, h.inf_eq_bot, bot_inf_eq, bot_sup_eq, inf_left_comm,
423       h'.inf_eq_bot, inf_bot_eq])
424     (by rw [sup_inf_left, sup_comm x, sup_assoc, h.sup_eq_top, sup_top_eq, top_inf_eq,
425       sup_assoc, sup_left_comm, h'.sup_eq_top, sup_top_eq])
426 
427 theorem inf_sup {x' y'} (h : IsCompl x y) (h' : IsCompl x' y') : IsCompl (x ⊓ x') (y ⊔ y') :=
428   (h.symm.sup_inf h'.symm).symm
429 
430 end IsCompl

432 namespace Prod
433 
434 variable {β : Type*} [PartialOrder α] [PartialOrder β]
435 
436 @[grind =]
437 protected theorem disjoint_iff [OrderBot α] [OrderBot β] {x y : α × β} :
438     Disjoint x y ↔ Disjoint x.1 y.1 ∧ Disjoint x.2 y.2 := by
439   constructor
440   · intro h
441     refine ⟨fun a hx hy ↦ (@h (a, ⊥) ⟨hx, ?_⟩ ⟨hy, ?_⟩).1,
442       fun b hx hy ↦ (@h (⊥, b) ⟨?_, hx⟩ ⟨?_, hy⟩).2⟩
443     all_goals exact bot_le
444   · rintro ⟨ha, hb⟩ z hza hzb
445     exact ⟨ha hza.1 hzb.1, hb hza.2 hzb.2⟩
446 
447 @[grind =]
448 protected theorem codisjoint_iff [OrderTop α] [OrderTop β] {x y : α × β} :
449     Codisjoint x y ↔ Codisjoint x.1 y.1 ∧ Codisjoint x.2 y.2 :=
450   @Prod.disjoint_iff αᵒᵈ βᵒᵈ _ _ _ _ _ _
451 
452 @[grind =]
453 protected theorem isCompl_iff [BoundedOrder α] [BoundedOrder β] {x y : α × β} :
454     IsCompl x y ↔ IsCompl x.1 y.1 ∧ IsCompl x.2 y.2 := by
455   simp_rw [isCompl_iff, Prod.disjoint_iff, Prod.codisjoint_iff, and_and_and_comm]
456 
457 end Prod

462 
463 @[simp, grind =]
464 theorem isCompl_toDual_iff : IsCompl (toDual a) (toDual b) ↔ IsCompl a b :=
465   ⟨IsCompl.ofDual, IsCompl.dual⟩
466 
467 @[simp, grind =]
468 theorem isCompl_ofDual_iff {a b : αᵒᵈ} : IsCompl (ofDual a) (ofDual b) ↔ IsCompl a b :=
469   ⟨IsCompl.dual, IsCompl.ofDual⟩
470 
471 theorem isCompl_bot_top : IsCompl (⊥ : α) ⊤ :=
472   IsCompl.of_eq (bot_inf_eq _) (sup_top_eq _)
473 
474 theorem isCompl_top_bot : IsCompl (⊤ : α) ⊥ :=
475   IsCompl.of_eq (inf_bot_eq _) (top_sup_eq _)
476 
477 theorem eq_top_of_isCompl_bot (h : IsCompl x ⊥) : x = ⊤ := by rw [← sup_bot_eq x, h.sup_eq_top]
478 
479 theorem eq_top_of_bot_isCompl (h : IsCompl ⊥ x) : x = ⊤ :=
480   eq_top_of_isCompl_bot h.symm
481 
482 theorem eq_bot_of_isCompl_top (h : IsCompl x ⊤) : x = ⊥ :=
483   eq_top_of_isCompl_bot h.dual
484 
485 theorem eq_bot_of_top_isCompl (h : IsCompl ⊤ x) : x = ⊥ :=
486   eq_top_of_bot_isCompl h.dual
487 
488 end
489 
490 section IsComplemented
491 
492 section Lattice
493 
494 variable [Lattice α] [BoundedOrder α]
495 
496 /-- An element is *complemented* if it has a complement. -/
497 def IsComplemented (a : α) : Prop :=
498   ∃ b, IsCompl a b
499 
500 theorem isComplemented_bot : IsComplemented (⊥ : α) :=
501   ⟨⊤, isCompl_bot_top⟩
502 
503 theorem isComplemented_top : IsComplemented (⊤ : α) :=
504   ⟨⊥, isCompl_top_bot⟩
505 
506 end Lattice
507 
508 variable [DistribLattice α] [BoundedOrder α] {a b : α}
509 
510 theorem IsComplemented.sup : IsComplemented a → IsComplemented b → IsComplemented (a ⊔ b) :=
511   fun ⟨a', ha⟩ ⟨b', hb⟩ => ⟨a' ⊓ b', ha.sup_inf hb⟩
512 
513 theorem IsComplemented.inf : IsComplemented a → IsComplemented b → IsComplemented (a ⊓ b) :=
514   fun ⟨a', ha⟩ ⟨b', hb⟩ => ⟨a' ⊔ b', ha.inf_sup hb⟩
515 
516 end IsComplemented
517 
518 /-- A complemented bounded lattice is one where every element has a (not necessarily unique)
519 complement. -/
520 class ComplementedLattice (α) [Lattice α] [BoundedOrder α] : Prop where
521   /-- In a `ComplementedLattice`, every element admits a complement. -/
522   exists_isCompl : ∀ a : α, ∃ b : α, IsCompl a b
523 
524 lemma complementedLattice_iff (α) [Lattice α] [BoundedOrder α] :
525     ComplementedLattice α ↔ ∀ a : α, ∃ b : α, IsCompl a b :=
526   ⟨fun ⟨h⟩ ↦ h, fun h ↦ ⟨h⟩⟩
527 
528 export ComplementedLattice (exists_isCompl)
529 
530 -- This was previously a global instance,
531 -- but it doesn't appear to be used and has been implicated in slow typeclass resolutions.
532 lemma Subsingleton.instComplementedLattice
533     [Lattice α] [BoundedOrder α] [Subsingleton α] : ComplementedLattice α := by
534   refine ⟨fun a ↦ ⟨⊥, disjoint_bot_right, ?_⟩⟩
535   rw [Subsingleton.elim ⊥ ⊤]
536   exact codisjoint_top_right
537 
538 namespace ComplementedLattice
539 
540 variable [Lattice α] [BoundedOrder α] [ComplementedLattice α]
541 
542 instance : ComplementedLattice αᵒᵈ :=
543   ⟨fun a ↦
544     let ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_isCompl (show α from a)
545     ⟨b, hb.dual⟩⟩
546 
547 end ComplementedLattice
548 
549 -- TODO: Define as a sublattice?
550 /-- The sublattice of complemented elements. -/
551 abbrev Complementeds (α : Type*) [Lattice α] [BoundedOrder α] : Type _ :=
552   {a : α // IsComplemented a}
553 
554 namespace Complementeds
555 
556 section Lattice
557 
558 variable [Lattice α] [BoundedOrder α] {a b : Complementeds α}
559 
560 instance hasCoeT : CoeTC (Complementeds α) α := ⟨Subtype.val⟩
561 
562 theorem coe_injective : Injective ((↑) : Complementeds α → α) := Subtype.coe_injective
563 
564 @[simp, norm_cast]
565 theorem coe_inj : (a : α) = b ↔ a = b := Subtype.coe_inj
566 
567 @[norm_cast]
568 theorem coe_le_coe : (a : α) ≤ b ↔ a ≤ b := by simp
569 
570 @[norm_cast]
571 theorem coe_lt_coe : (a : α) < b ↔ a < b := by simp
572 
573 instance : BoundedOrder (Complementeds α) :=
574   Subtype.boundedOrder isComplemented_bot isComplemented_top
575 
576 @[simp, norm_cast]
577 theorem coe_bot : ((⊥ : Complementeds α) : α) = ⊥ := rfl
578 
579 @[simp, norm_cast]
580 theorem coe_top : ((⊤ : Complementeds α) : α) = ⊤ := rfl
581 
582 theorem mk_bot : (⟨⊥, isComplemented_bot⟩ : Complementeds α) = ⊥ := by simp
583 
584 theorem mk_top : (⟨⊤, isComplemented_top⟩ : Complementeds α) = ⊤ := by simp
585 
586 instance : Inhabited (Complementeds α) := ⟨⊥⟩
587 
588 end Lattice
589 
590 variable [DistribLattice α] [BoundedOrder α] {a b : Complementeds α}
591 
592 instance : Max (Complementeds α) :=
593   ⟨fun a b => ⟨a ⊔ b, a.2.sup b.2⟩⟩
594 
595 instance : Min (Complementeds α) :=
596   ⟨fun a b => ⟨a ⊓ b, a.2.inf b.2⟩⟩
597 
598 @[simp, norm_cast]
599 theorem coe_sup (a b : Complementeds α) : ↑(a ⊔ b) = (a : α) ⊔ b := rfl
600 
601 @[simp, norm_cast]
602 theorem coe_inf (a b : Complementeds α) : ↑(a ⊓ b) = (a : α) ⊓ b := rfl
603 
604 @[simp]
605 theorem mk_sup_mk {a b : α} (ha : IsComplemented a) (hb : IsComplemented b) :
606     (⟨a, ha⟩ ⊔ ⟨b, hb⟩ : Complementeds α) = ⟨a ⊔ b, ha.sup hb⟩ := rfl
607 
608 @[simp]
609 theorem mk_inf_mk {a b : α} (ha : IsComplemented a) (hb : IsComplemented b) :
610     (⟨a, ha⟩ ⊓ ⟨b, hb⟩ : Complementeds α) = ⟨a ⊓ b, ha.inf hb⟩ := rfl
611 
612 instance : DistribLattice (Complementeds α) :=
613   Complementeds.coe_injective.distribLattice _ .rfl .rfl coe_sup coe_inf
614 
615 @[simp, norm_cast]
616 theorem disjoint_coe : Disjoint (a : α) b ↔ Disjoint a b := by
617   rw [disjoint_iff, disjoint_iff, ← coe_inf, ← coe_bot, coe_inj]
618 
619 @[simp, norm_cast]
620 theorem codisjoint_coe : Codisjoint (a : α) b ↔ Codisjoint a b := by
621   rw [codisjoint_iff, codisjoint_iff, ← coe_sup, ← coe_top, coe_inj]
622 
623 @[simp, norm_cast]
624 theorem isCompl_coe : IsCompl (a : α) b ↔ IsCompl a b := by
625   simp_rw [isCompl_iff, disjoint_coe, codisjoint_coe]
626 
627 instance : ComplementedLattice (Complementeds α) :=
628   ⟨fun ⟨a, b, h⟩ => ⟨⟨b, a, h.symm⟩, isCompl_coe.1 h⟩⟩
629 
630 end Complementeds
631 end IsCompl
